## What is SlideAI?

- A CLI + library for building Quarto/RevealJS slide decks
- Scaffolding, screenshots, rendering, and live preview

## Create a Deck

- Start from a template with consistent styling
- Pass a bulleted outline to auto-generate slides

## Capture Screenshots

- Point at live URLs and capture them as slides
- Auto-scrolls to charts, tables, and plots

## Render and Watch

- Render to HTML or PDF with one command
- Watch mode auto-renders on every save

## Agent Integration

- Every command works as a CLI tool or JavaScript function
- Structured results for agentic workflows
- Skill files describe each capability for AI agents
